params.template:
Kavira Pharmaceuticals is announcing the launch of Acneclear Gel (adapalene 0.1% + clindamycin 1%, a 15 g tube for acne, launched June 2025) to its medical representatives. Write the announcement as one WhatsApp message in the main language of the branch below: Kannada for Karnataka, Tamil for Tamil Nadu, Malayalam for Kerala.
